ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added an exit clause because the Agreement gives us no right to our data back or to migration help on exit (Section 16.5 cross-refers to a Section 11 that does not exist). The 30-day return runs from expiry or termination of the Agreement rather than from a request, so continuing Order Forms are unaffected; we can work with 90 days of assistance and export only if that suits your delivery model better.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 10.3: up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter.
